chunks: Al-Abbas ibn Ma'ruf from Fadalah from al-Ala' from Muhammad ibn Muslim from one of the Imams (peace be upon them both) who said:
Whoever resides in Mecca for a year is in the same status as the people of Mecca.

key_terms.بِمَنْزِلَةِ: In the status of / Equivalent to

ai.seo_question: What is the legal status of a visitor to Mecca who stays for a year?
ai.summary: In the context of *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, this hadith clarifies the transition from the status of a traveler (*Musafir*) to a resident (*Muqim*) for the purpose of shortening prayers (*Qasr*) and other ritual obligations. It establishes that residing in Mecca for a full lunar year grants one the legal standing of the city's permanent inhabitants, thereby affecting the applicability of specific pilgrimage rules and prayer lengths.
